x_compost_bin.lore.rare: Turns banana skins into soil so fast that the gardener suspects magic.

x_hoverboard.lore.rare: Carries its rider sideways into the kitchen when they only meant to go forwards.

tulip.lore.rare: Changes colour each spring, so the gardener has to guess what it will be this time.

x_fern_frond.lore.rare: Looks so prehistoric that every child expects a dinosaur to come round the corner.

x_fishing_reel.lore.common: Snags its hook on the angler's own hat on the very first cast.

x_sprinkler.lore.epic: Was left on all night by mistake, and the whole garden turned into a swamp full of happy frogs.

x_wheelie_bin.lore.epic: Was blown over in a gale and carried down the street like a runaway sledge, lid flapping.

x_flower_bouquet.lore.rare: Drops one petal every hour, so its owner always knows exactly how old it is.

x_leaf.lore.common: Sticks to the bottom of your shoe and gets walked all the way into the house.

x_reed.lore.common: Rustles so loudly by the pond that the fishermen think someone is sneaking up behind them.

x_peony.lore.rare: Opens from a tight little ball to a flower the size of a dinner plate overnight.

x_rubber_plant.lore.rare: Pushes out a new leaf wrapped in a red sheath, like a present being unwrapped.

x_seed_pod.lore.uncommon: Hitches a ride on the dog's fur and gets planted three streets away.

x_vine.lore.epic: Wound itself through the garden furniture so tightly that the family ate dinner on the lawn for a month.

x_water_lily.lore.epic: Covered the whole village pond so thickly that the ducks walked across it.
x_water_lily.lore.rare: Hides its flower under the water on cold days and pops it up again when the sun comes out.
